column1: # Arabic (ar) catalog. Same format as zh-hant.tsv:  context <TAB> source <TAB> translation
# (empty context = a plain UI string; `@id` = a command id; `@plural` = "one|other" source forms,
# six Arabic forms separated by `|` in the translation).
# Clean-room: written from the meaning of VectorCraft's English labels in neutral Modern Standard
# Arabic, using the vector-illustration vocabulary Arabic-speaking users know (لوح الرسم، مسار،
# حد، تعبئة، عينة، تدرج، نمط، رمز، فرشاة، طبقة، مجموعة). Shortcut keys keep their key-cap names
# Coverage: the whole interface — every menu string and every `tl!` literal (`complete_menus`,
# tested) — and the status and error messages (`@msg` rows at the end, `COMPLETE_MESSAGES`,
# tested). Left in English on purpose (`MENU_KEEP_AS_IS` in the tests): the product name, language
# names, OpenType, the built-in workspace names and the bracketed perspective grid preset names.
